name: vyuha
description: VYUHA — dynamic air operations planning and resource optimisation. Synthetic prototype.

scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @vyuha/web lint && uv run --directory services/api ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @vyuha/web typecheck && uv run --directory services/api mypy app optimiser fusion analytics scenarios
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @vyuha/web test && uv run --directory services/api pytest
scripts.seed: uv run --directory services/api python -m scenarios.cli seed
scripts.contracts: uv run --directory services/api python -m app.export_openapi && pnpm --filter @vyuha/contracts generate
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @vyuha/web format && uv run --directory services/api ruff format .
